text:
negative sampling distribution --can_induce--> source shortcut
Evidence: hypothesis_from_reported_mechanism
Source: https://www.kaggle.com/code/senanuretin/casmi26-score-head-v3
Paper: H89 section3.3
A model can recognize catalog provenance instead of spectrum compatibility.
Not an independently reproduced improvement.

shifted peak null --estimates--> accidental fragment matches
Evidence: unvalidated_null_control
Source: https://www.kaggle.com/code/vlakarlo/casmi-fr-train
Paper: H89 section5.2
Dense fragment sets can explain noise; shifted peaks estimate accidental matching, subject to calibration.
Not an independently reproduced improvement.

within-query fragment rarity --may_improve--> discriminative evidence
Evidence: theory_analogy
Source: https://www.kaggle.com/code/truthseeking/casmi-2026-progress-report
Paper: H89 section5.3
Fragments shared by almost every candidate convey little discrimination.
Not an independently reproduced improvement.

formula-block position preservation --bounds--> intervention rank range
Evidence: reported_mechanism
Source: https://www.kaggle.com/code/zelza0/casmi-i2-rrf-isomer
Paper: H89 section8.4
Preserving a formula family position constrains cross-formula errors; it does not guarantee a better ordering.
Not an independently reproduced improvement.

selective replacement gate --trades_off--> replacement coverage and error
Evidence: theory_interpretation
Source: https://www.kaggle.com/code/romantamrazov/casmi-2026-spectral-parallax
Paper: H89 section8.3
A replacement threshold trades how often the leader changes against errors among replacements.
Not an independently reproduced improvement.

query mass difference --constrains--> transformation candidates
Evidence: testable_hypothesis
Source: https://www.kaggle.com/code/tamerlanomralinov/casmi26-stage2-class3-sim
Paper: H89 section6.2
Restrict transformations to plausible spectral neighbors and compatible mass differences.
Not an independently reproduced improvement.

generative fragment likelihood --may_support--> positional isomer discrimination
Evidence: testable_hypothesis
Source: https://www.kaggle.com/code/toasthink/casmi26-gs-egnn-analysis
Paper: H89 section2
Candidates can share masses but differ in likely fragmentation pathways; requires own heldout testing.
Not an independently reproduced improvement.
